change: Stage 2 v5.3: the A34 closure first revokes ACL entries granted TO the separate physical superuser role named postgres (residue of releases run before ACL grantees were mapped) on objects the release owner owns, before its unchanged fail-closed check. The contract export maps that role and the owner to the same logical owner and the step refuses any revoke that would change that view, so the sealed contract is unchanged.
